scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I trust that you are enjoying
life as a Super Novice? Ah,
good good...just as I expected.
Verily, the light of mediocrity is shining brightly within you...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
超级初心者的生活，你一定很享受吧？
啊，很好，很好...果然不出我所料。
平庸的光辉，正在你心中闪耀...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I encourage you to live
life as Mister Kimu-Shaun did...
Become a Jack of All Trades...
...and a master of none.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
希望你像金姆·肖恩先生那样生活...
样样都会...
...却样样不精。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Ah, you've brought the
items I've requested!
You've proven yourself
worthy of joining our
Super Novice Society.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
啊，我要的东西，你都带来了！
你已经证明自己有资格加入超级初心者协会。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Then, as promised, I will
change your job into a
^3355FFSuper Novi--^000000Huh?
What's that behind you?
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
那么，按约定，我就让你转职为^3355FF超级初——^000000咦？
你身后是什么？

scripts.text: Huh?
scripts.translation: 咦？

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什么？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou look behind you, but...
There's nothing's there.
Something fishy is going on here!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你回头一看，却...
什么都没有。
这事有点蹊跷！^000000

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Bwaha! I got you!
So...how do you like my joke?
Oh well, let's forget that...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
Bwaha! 上当了吧！
怎么样，我这玩笑还不错吧？
算了，不提这个了...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
As well as any possible
reason a grown man such as
myself would carry around
a pair of Panties.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
也别问我一个大男人，为什么会随身带着一条内裤了。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
The important thing is...
you have joined the esteemed
ranks of the great Super Novices.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
重要的是...你已经光荣地加入伟大的超级初心者行列！

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Consider these Panties a gift...
This very garment is rumored
to be worn by Mister Kimu-Shaun,
our legendary club founder, in
his early days in striving for
exemplary mediocrity.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
这条内裤，就当作送你的礼物吧...
据说，我们的传奇创始人金姆·肖恩先生，早年追求极致平庸时，穿的就是它。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Go out, and enjoy your new life
as a Super Novice! Venture
forth and help the common
man, while being one at at
the same time!
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
去吧，享受超级初心者的新生活！
去冒险，帮助普通人，同时也做一个普通人！

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Huh? Did you forget what I
wanted from you? Okay,
I will let you know once
again. Please remember
this time...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
咦？忘了我要你带什么？
好吧，我再说一次，这回可要记住...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I asked you to bring me
^FF000030 Sticky Mucus^000000 and
^FF000030 Resin^000000.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
我要你带来^FF000030个粘稠液体^000000和^FF000030个树脂^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
...Hmm?
Stop.
Let me look at you.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
...嗯？
等等，让我看看你。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I see that the light
of mediocrity shines
brightly within you...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
我看见了，你心中正闪耀着平庸的光辉...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Why don't you join us,
young Novice? Join
us and learn the subtle
greatness of being
mediocre...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
年轻的初心者，何不加入我们？
和我们一起，领悟平庸之中不为人知的伟大...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Accept my offer...
Cast off your those
brown, dusty garments
and bloom into...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
接受我的提议吧...
脱下那身沾满尘土的棕色衣服，蜕变成...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
...a ^CE6300Super Novice^000000.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
...一位^CE6300超级初心者^000000。

scripts.text: Accept his offer.
scripts.translation: 接受他的提议

scripts.text: Reject his offer.
scripts.translation: 拒绝他的提议

scripts.text: Listen more carefully.
scripts.translation: 再仔细听听

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Hmm...But do you truly
appreciate the value of
finding strength in
weakness? You must
prove to me that you
are a true underachiever.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
嗯...不过，你真的懂得从弱小中寻找力量的价值吗？
你必须向我证明，你是真正的平庸之人。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Live life as a Novice...
And return when you
have mastered the
Basic Skills...
Grow in mediocrity and
Become a Level 10 Novice...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
继续以初心者的身份生活...
掌握基本技能之后，再回来...
在平庸中成长，成为10级的初心者...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Hmm...But do you truly
value the relaxed lifestyle
of the banal adventurer?
Prove to me that you do not
lust for power...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
嗯...你真的珍视平凡冒险者那悠闲的生活吗？
证明给我看，你并不贪求力量...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Live life mundanely...
Become a Level 45 Novice...
It will be then that you can join us...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
平凡地生活...
成为一名45级的初心者...
到那时，你才能加入我们...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I can see in your eyes
the determination to
live life simply...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
我从你的眼中，看到了过简单生活的决心...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Only the truly wise can
see that being ordinary
and banal is the best
way to live life.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
只有真正有智慧的人，才能明白平凡、平庸才是最好的生活方式。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
However, we do not welcome
just anyone into our society.
You must first pass our
qualification test.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
不过，我们的协会可不是谁都能加入的。
你得先通过资格测试。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
For this test, you must
bring me some items which
are dropped from normal,
unexceptional monsters.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
测试的内容，就是带来一些普通魔物掉落的物品。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Hmmmm...
^FF000030 Sticky Mucus^000000
and ^FF000030 Resin
^000000will be suitable to test your
ability to fight meager enemies.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
嗯...
^FF000030个粘稠液体^000000和^FF000030个树脂^000000，就足以考验你对付弱小敌人的能力了。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Also, the number 30
is significant. It's not
anything special...just
an ordinary number.
Hahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
还有，30这个数字也很有意义。
它没什么特别的...只是个普通数字。
Hahahahaha~

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Good luck, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
祝你好运，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Well, well...I suppose the
value of the simple life
is difficult for you to
to grasp. It's...okay...
Your life is your own.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
唉...看来你还很难领会简单生活的价值。
没...没关系...
你的人生，由你做主。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
But, if you ever see the
light of banality, you
are welcome to visit me
anytime...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
不过，哪天你若看见了平庸的光辉，随时欢迎来找我...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
As our Novice club
grows more popular and
we gain more followers,
we may consider using
a more difficult test...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
等初心者协会越来越受欢迎，追随者越来越多，我们也许会考虑采用更难的测试...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Our Novice Society was founded
by the legendary Mister
Kimu-Shaun...perhaps the
greatest man in our generation.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
我们的初心者协会，由传奇人物金姆·肖恩先生创立...
他或许是我们这一代最伟大的人。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
He realized that there
was much suffering in the
world, especially among
the common people of
Midgard...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
他发现，世间充满苦难，尤其是米德加尔特的普通百姓...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
He learned many skills from
all the different people he
met...but since he didn't
stay in one place for long,
he became a jack of all
trades...and a master of none.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
他向旅途中遇到的各种人学习，掌握了许多技能...
可他从不在一处久留，最后成了样样都会...却样样不精的人。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
In sharing the pain of
the common man, he became
became one himself...
the greatest ordinary
man ever.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
他与普通人分担痛苦，自己也成了其中一员...
成了有史以来最伟大的普通人。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
The members of our society
try to live as Mister
Kimu-Shaun did, according to
the principles he laid before us...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
我们协会的成员，都努力遵循金姆·肖恩先生留下的原则，像他那样生活...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
How do you like living
life simply as a Super
Novice? I'm sure that
you're enjoying it~
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
身为超级初心者，过着简单的生活，感觉如何？
我相信，你一定很享受~

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Please grow as a Super
Novice by helping the
common man while being
one at the same time...
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
身为超级初心者，帮助普通人的同时，也保持自己的平凡，以此不断成长...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
I encourage you to
grow in your Super
Noviceness, and lead
an example in living
an exceptionally
mundane life.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
希望你不断提升超级初心者的境界，以身作则，过上极其平凡的生活。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Hello, I am Tzerero,
the unofficial executive
director of the Great
Novice Society.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
你好，我是泽雷罗，伟大初心者协会的非正式执行总监。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Hmmm...you seem to be well
above the average person.
Yes, you're definitely more
'extraordinary' than you are
'ordinary...'
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
嗯...你似乎远胜于普通人。
没错，比起“平凡”，你显然更称得上“非凡”...

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
*Sigh* I suppose you
could never understand
our way of life, the
subtle greatness in
being ordinary. But
that's alright.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
*叹气*看来，你很难理解我们的生活方式，理解平凡之中那不为人知的伟大。
不过，没关系。

scripts.text:
[Tzerero]
Well...there are thousands
of different people in this
world, so I just try to accept
all of our differences.
I hope you will too.
scripts.translation:
[泽雷罗]
嗯...世间有形形色色的人，我也试着接受彼此的差异。
希望你也能如此。

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
You! Stronger than before.
I knew you could pass the test~
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
你呀！比以前更强了。
我就知道你能通过测试~

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Hm? Hey, you're a member
of our great Novice Society,
aren't you? Isn't this the
best club ever?!
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
嗯？嘿，你是我们伟大初心者协会的成员吧？
这难道不是世上最棒的协会吗？！

scripts.text:
[Essaray]
Living life mundanely,
according to the principles
of Mister Kimu-Shaun...
It's great to be ordinary!
scripts.translation:
[艾萨雷]
遵循金姆·肖恩先生的原则，平凡地生活...
做个普通人真好！

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Let's try to lead our lives
as normally as we can!
For your reference, I am
the number one member,
under Mister Tzerero of
course!
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
让我们尽量过平凡的生活吧！
顺便一提，我可是协会的头号成员！
当然，泽雷罗先生除外！

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Hah~ you don't know anything
about being a normal person yet!
Why don't you join our Novice
Society? This club is the best in the world~
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
哈~你还不懂做普通人的滋味呢！
何不加入我们的初心者协会？
这可是世上最棒的协会~

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Yup, Super Novices
are the best characters!
Hahahahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
没错，超级初心者是最棒的角色！
Hahahahahahahaha!

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Bah~! You're better than
average...Hell, you may
even be 'special.'
What a shame! Well...
I hope you still live
your life positively.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
嘁~！你比普通人强...天哪，甚至称得上“特别”。
真遗憾！不过...还是希望你积极地生活。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hello, Mister Super Novice~
You must have been really
dissapointed that the other
Kafra Employees wouldn't let
you rent a cart from them.
But don't you worry now...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
您好，超级初心者先生~
其他卡普拉职员不肯租手推车给您，您一定很失望吧。
不过，现在不用担心了...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hello, Super Novice, Ma'am.
You must have been really
dissapointed that the other
Kafra Employees wouldn't let
you rent a cart from them.
But don't you worry now...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
您好，超级初心者女士。
其他卡普拉职员不肯租手推车给您，您一定很失望吧。
不过，现在不用担心了...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm here to support you guys
by providing carts...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
我就是来为你们提供手推车，支持你们的...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^3355FF*whispers*^000000
^555555I am not supposed to do this
because it's against our
company policy. But I felt
really sorry for Super Novices
...so here I am.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
^3355FF*小声说*^000000
^555555其实，我不该这么做，因为这违反了公司规定。
可我实在不忍心看超级初心者这么为难...所以就来了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Anyway, would you like to rent a cart? The service fee is 1,900 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
那么，您想租用手推车吗？
服务费是1,900 Zeny。

scripts.text: Rent a Cart.
scripts.translation: 租用手推车

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Oh, here's the thing...
Have you learned the 'Push Cart'
skill? I can just rent you a
cart, but if you haven't
learned to push it, you'll
just be wasting your zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
哦，还有件事...
您学会“手推车使用”技能了吗？
我可以租手推车给您，但如果您不会使用，就只是白白浪费Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
So make sure that you have
the 'Push Cart' skill already.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
所以，请先确认自己已经学会“手推车使用”技能。

scripts.text: Rent a Cart.
scripts.translation: 租用手推车

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Oh, you've already equipped a cart.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
哦，您已经有手推车了。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Thank you for using my service.
Although what I am doing might
not be legitimate to other
Kafra Employees, I strongly
believe I am doing what's right for the customers.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
感谢您使用我的服务。
虽然其他卡普拉职员可能认为这不合规，但我坚信，我是在为顾客做正确的事。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I am sorry, but you do not have enough zeny with you. The service fee is 1,900 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足。
服务费是1,900 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Please come again.
Thank you for using my services.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
欢迎再次光临。
感谢您使用我的服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Please come again.
Thank you for using my services.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
欢迎再次光临。
感谢您使用我的服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Good da--Oops...!
I don't think I can provide you
with the services you want...
Please go talk to another
Kafra employee. I apologize
for such inconvenience...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
您好——哎呀...！
恐怕我无法提供您需要的服务...
请找其他卡普拉职员。
给您带来不便，实在抱歉...
